_meta.description: Score a battery of numeric fields row by row through a named vector on experiment.pulse: the vector names revenue_before, revenue and session_minutes once, ATTR_FORMULA takes the mean of the valid members only when at least 2 of 3 answered (vcount(spend) >= 2 ? vmean(spend) : nil — fewer is a null score, not a 0) and flags a flat profile with vsd(spend) == 0, the straight-lining check of a rating battery. Both are averaged per treatment arm.
_meta.name: attr_vector_battery_score
